Second, [me] reported hitting a roadblock while working on fake demographics (tracked via DOOH-428). Although all backend work was completed on the server side, the front end failed to send requests to the endpoints. Attempts to resolve this by providing fake variables or disabling them in the database were unsuccessful. A follow-up review of the front-end issue is scheduled for the next day.
decisions: The technical issues with the front-end requesting demographic data will be reviewed on the following day.
